company.description: Venue.ink provides booking and payment software for tattoo artists and studios. The platform enables artists and studios to receive booking requests, manage their calendars, and organize deposits and payments. Clients can submit custom requests or select flash designs, upload reference images, and book appointments through personalized links. Venue.ink supports configurable booking forms, client messaging, and text reminders to reduce no-shows. The software centralizes communication, scheduling, and payment processing so tattoo professionals can manage their client workflow in one place.
